prompts.name: rat-market
prompts.prompt: Wide 1536x1024 landscape battle backdrop for Paper Peanut: underground rat flea market with bottlecap stalls, patchwork purple awnings, amber lanterns, tiny scrap goods, brick sewer arches. Handcrafted layered paper cutout diorama, tactile cardstock, cream cut edges, purple stitched scrapbook aesthetic. No characters, no words. Broad clear horizontal stone platform across lower quarter for combat, scenery behind. Warm plum and amber palette.
